newsitem.title: USA: Ag Services to meet rev, earnings targets.
newsitem.headline: Ag Services to meet rev, earnings targets.

text.p: Ag Services of America Inc, which earlier reported higher first-quarter earnings, said it expects to meet its revenue and earnings targets for fiscal year 1998.
The agricultural supply company said it continues to expect to meet its previously stated goal of 20 to 25 percent growth in revenues and earnings this year.
The company earlier said it earned $1.9 million or $0.36 a share on a fully diluted basis in the first quarter compared to $1.6 million or $0.33 a diluted share in the first quarter of last year.

Gross margins on the sale of farm inputs were reduced during the period, Ag Services said. But this was offset by lower financing expense due to the conversion of its $13.8 million subordinated debentures into common stock in the second quarter a year ago and the implementation of an asset backed securitization program in March of 1997.

"Furthermore the shift toward larger and higher quality producers has put pressure on margins but creates the foundation necessary for long-term growth and profitability," Ag Services said in a statement.
